CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  November 25, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Stanley Tsai; Steve Kuchenski, Secretary

  Staff Present: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – October 28, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the October 28, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the October 28, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Tsai

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-124
  • 1617 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Marcos Munoz
  • Request: This is an application for a new front and side yard fence
  on an existing single-family residential property.
  • Recommended Action: CONTINUANCE - The proposed project is
  continued with the following design considerations:

  1
  11/25/2025
   1. The applicant should continue to evaluate the proposed fence
  style to ensure compatibility with the existing Spanish Revival
  residence. City staff recommends that the applicant select a
  fence or low wall that incorporates stucco, wrought iron,
  and/or tile elements that are complementary to the
  architectural style of the home.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the application with the following conditions:
  1. The applicant should continue to evaluate the proposed fence
  style to ensure compatibility with the existing Spanish Revival
  residence. City staff recommends that the applicant select a
  fence or low wall that incorporates stucco, wrought iron, brick,
  and/or wood elements that are consistent with and
  complementary to the Spanish architectural style.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Tsai

ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-128
  • 123 South Chapel Avenue
  • Applicant: Terry Abrahamian

  2
  11/25/2025
   •  Request: This is an application for a sign program for new building
  signage associated with a recently constructed 4-story mixed-use
  building.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Any future tenants occupying the existing ground-floor
  commercial space shall be required to obtain Design Review
  Board approval for any proposed individual tenant signage,
  unless this sign program is subsequently amended to
  establish standards governing tenant signage.
  2. Should the commercial tenant space be divided into four or
  more commercial units in the future, an amendment to this
  sign program shall be required and shall include standards
  governing tenant signage.
  3. The “Now Leasing” signs shall be limited to an 18-month
  display time from the date the sign permits are finaled by the
  Building Division. Following the expiration of the advertising
  banner display period, the changeable banners shall be
  replaced with decorative, non-commercial designs and
  messaging. The design and display time of any future
  changeable banner signs shall be subject to review and
  approval by the Community Development Director and shall
  be submitted for review no less than 30 days prior to
  installation, unless this sign program is subsequently
  amended to include sample designs and associated display
  periods.
  4. Any amendments to this sign program shall be subject to
  review and approval by the Design Review Board.
  5. The applicant shall update Sheet 2 of the sign plan to include
  the above conditions and submit the revised plans to the City
  Architect and the Planning Division for approval.
  6. The applicant shall revise sheet 11 to clarify the proposed font
  style used on all signage included in the sign program.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Any future tenants occupying the existing ground-floor
  commercial space shall be required to obtain Design Review
  Board approval for any proposed individual tenant signage,
  unless this sign program is subsequently amended to
  establish standards governing tenant signage.
  2. Should the commercial tenant space be divided into four or
  more commercial units in the future, an amendment to this
  sign program shall be required and shall include standards
  governing tenant signage.
  3. The “Now Leasing” signs shall be limited to an 18-month
  display time from the date the sign permits are finaled by the
  Building Division. Following the expiration of the advertising
  banner display period, the changeable banners shall be

  3

   replaced with decorative, non-commercial designs and
  messaging. The design and display time of any future
  changeable banner signs shall be subject to review and
  approval by the Community Development Director and shall
  be submitted for review no less than 30 days prior to
  installation, unless this sign program is subsequently
  amended to include sample designs and associated display
  periods.
  4. Any amendments to this sign program shall be subject to
  review and approval by the Design Review Board.
  5. The applicant shall update Sheet 2 of the sign plan to include
  the above conditions and submit the revised plans to the City
  Architect and the Planning Division for approval.
  6. The applicant shall revise sheet 11 to clarify the proposed font
  style used on all signage included in the sign program.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.

ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-137
  • 1 East Main Street

  4
  11/25/2025
   •  Applicant: Kathy Lovell
  •  Request: This is an application for new signage and exterior repaint
  on an existing movie theater historically known as the “Edwards
  Theater,” currently operated and occupied by ‘Regal’.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of

 ITEM 8:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-025
  • 1608 South Sierra Vista Avenue
  • Applicant: Lori Pazula
  • Request: This is an application for the new construction of a 3,026
  SF 1-story second unit with an attached 423 SF garage located in the
  rear, and exterior alterations to the existing 1,232 SF 1-story
  Craftsman style single-family residence situated at the front of the lot.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall include a note on the architectural plans
  indicating that all window grids shall be permanently applied
  to the exterior surface of the glass, which provides definition
  and achieves the appearance of true divided lites consistent
  with the Craftsman style.
  2. The applicant shall provide an image and/or product
  specification for the proposed stone base material, including
  details regarding its color and finish, to be included on the
  Material Board for review and approval by the City Architect.
  The selected stone material shall display a natural and
  authentic appearance and shall be appropriately scaled for
  column piers in a manner consistent with the Craftsman
  architectural character.
  3. The applicant shall provide detailed information regarding the
  proposed entry doors for both the main house and the rear
  second unit. The door style, material, and color shall be
  compatible with the Craftsman style and complementary to
  the proposed exterior color palette, such as a solid single-
  swing door with half-lite or no glass.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall provide an image and/or product
  specification for the proposed stone base material, including
  details regarding its color and finish, to be included on the
  Material Board for review and approval by the City Architect.
  The selected stone material shall display a natural and
  authentic appearance and shall be appropriately scaled for
  column piers in a manner consistent with the Craftsman
  architectural character.
  2. The applicant shall provide detailed information regarding the
  proposed entry doors for both the main house and the rear
  second unit. The door style, material, and color shall be
  compatible with the Craftsman style and complementary to
  the proposed exterior color palette, such as a solid single-
  swing door with half-lite or no glass.
  3. The applicant shall revise the proposed exterior lighting and
  select a fixture that is more compatible with the Craftsman
  architectural style and less reflective of a Modern aesthetic.

  6
  11/25/2025
   4. The applicant shall revise the drawings to depict windows
  without proposed grids and shall update the window schedule
  and elevations accordingly.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chair Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 2-1-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger
  Noes:  Ng
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 9:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-133
  • 1840 South Fourth Street
  • Applicant: Dat Wong
  • Request: This is an application for the demolition of the existing main
  house, including garage and patio, and the new construction of a
  2,320 SF 2-story single-family residence with an attached 2-car
  garage located at the rear of the property.
  • Recommended Action: CONTINUANCE - The proposed project is
  continued with the following design considerations:
  1. The applicant should continue to study the overall design of
  the front porch— including the roof form, proportions, and
  articulation— to ensure compatibility with the intended Ranch-
  style character. Particular attention should be given to
  maintaining a low profile, sheltering the front entry beneath
  the primary roof structure, employing porch supports that are
  simple in form, and reinforcing a building composition that
  emphasizes horizontal expression.
  2. The applicant should continue to refine the selection of the
  stone base material so that it conveys a natural and authentic
  appearance and is appropriately scaled to the building.
  3. The applicant should continue to evaluate the style, material,
  and color of all exterior doors—including the entry door, patio
  door, and garage door— to ensure a cohesive design
  approach and compatibility with the Ranch architectural
  character.
  4. The applicant should continue to evaluate the style and
  material of the proposed front yard fence design to ensure a
  cohesive design approach and compatibility with the Ranch
  architectural character.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the application with the following conditions:
  1. The applicant should continue to study the overall design of
  the new residence—including the front porch, roof height, roof
  pitch, proportions, and articulation—to ensure compatibility
  with the intended Ranch-style character. Should the applicant

  7
  11/25/2025

  elect to pursue a different architectural style, the design
  should clearly reflect the chosen style.
  2. The applicant should continue to refine the Material Board as
  necessary so that it demonstrates the use of natural and
  authentic materials and colors consistent with the selected
  architectural character of the proposed single-family
  residence.
  3. The applicant should continue to evaluate the style and
  materials of the proposed front yard fence to ensure a
  cohesive design approach and compatibility with the selected
  architectural character of the proposed single-family
  residence.
  4. The applicant should include proposed color elevations for all
  four sides of the building to allow for an appropriate and
  comprehensive evaluation of the project's design.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chair Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Tsai
